resources.string: The preview updates while dragging. Changes are saved and applied to the interface when you release the slider. Remove backdrop behind navigation hides the solid backing behind bottom folders and navigation without changing the panels themselves. Message, folder and bottom navigation background transparency can be adjusted separately without fading text or icons. For folders and navigation: 0% is opaque, 100% is fully transparent. Brightness, contrast and saturation adjust interface surfaces, accents and bubble colors, not photos or wallpaper images. Contrast is not image sharpening. The original theme is unchanged: disable adjustments or reset to restore it. Incoming and outgoing messages can use independent transparency or the shared value (leftmost position). Leftmost corner settings restore the theme default. Blur: 100% is original, 0% disables it; supported glass panels on Android 12+ only, not text or photos. Blur may be invisible on solid surfaces or when effects are disabled. Check blur intensity on interface panels after releasing the slider, not in the schematic preview. Three named slots save all parameters; loading a preset enables adjustments. Reset does not delete saved presets. Check text readability when choosing colors. Transparency and stronger blur may use more graphics resources.
Preset is empty, damaged, or could not be saved
